info.name: SkillHub API
info.description:
SkillHub backend — catalog (vendors, products, courses, taxonomies), CMS (pages, sections, placements, themes), navigation, blogs, search, uploads.

Themes accept **Colors** (`brand_primary`, `brand_hover`, `ink`) + **Surface** (`surface_mode` / `surface_pattern`) only.

Also available as Swagger UI at `{{baseUrl}}/api-docs`.

No auth on local API. Use the Local environment or collection `baseUrl` (default http://127.0.0.1:3000).

request.description: Raw OpenAPI 3 document (same source as Swagger UI).

item.name: Vendors
item.description: Catalog vendors — soft-delete via DELETE, restore via POST …/restore.

request.description: Paginated list. Query: page, limit, status, isVerified, q.
Required: name, email. Saves slug + id to collection variables.

body.raw:
{ "name": "Postman Vendor", "email": "postman-vendor@example.com", "shortDescription": "Created from Postman collection", "overviewTitle": "Build skills with Postman Vendor", "overview": "

Sample overview body for Postman.

", "status": "active", "isVerified": false, "categories": [ "cloud" ] }

request.description: Set vendorId from Create vendor (or a seeded vendor).
Faceted catalog. Multi-ids are comma-separated ObjectIds.
Body shape may accept ids or slugs — check controller.

item.name: Blogs
item.description: Not yet in OpenAPI YAML — included here from routes.

body.raw:
{ "title": "Postman Blog Post", "excerpt": "Short excerpt", "content": "

Hello from Postman.

", "category": "engineering", "tags": [ "cms", "demo" ], "status": "active", "featured": false }

item.name: Sections
item.description: CMS section catalog + page tags. Content fields only (title, subtitle, image, buttons, items, data).

request.description: Create catalog section (key, name, content fields).
Editable content fields only. Retired band fields are cleared server-side.
Resolved placements for the template. Pass entity_id for vendor/product overrides.
Optional `theme` patch uses Colors + Surface keys only.

item.name: Page Sections
item.description: Template tags + EntityPageSection overrides/extras. Band bg/theme fields are not writable.

item.name: Site Theme
item.description: Global theme (key=default). Accepts Colors + Surface only.

request.description: Patch theme fields: preset, brand_primary, brand_hover, ink, surface_mode, surface_pattern. Empty body → 400.

item.name: Entity Page Theme
item.description: Per-entity theme override for a page_key (Colors + Surface; no page background).

request.description: Upsert entity theme override. Nested `theme` uses the same field keys as site theme.
1×1 PNG. Max 4MB. Allowed: jpeg, png, webp, gif. Returns `{ url, path }`.
